items.title: Jimmy Wormworth interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: And I can remember hearing Lester Young’s group from Birdland as well, broadcasting, with Jesse Drakes playing trumpet and Gildo playing piano and Connie Kaye playing © Fillius Jazz Archive -11- drums, and I think John Ore was the bassist.

ctx.x: To get out of that life?

Well no because he, sort of like Lester Young said well man, the girls will go around with all these other guys while I’m packing up the drums. My father was a little variation of that. He didn’t want to carry all that stuff when he got a little feeling good at the end of the gig, so he ended up playing piano. And he played very well.
